scope: Scoped Ty2 axiom/replacement calculus and standard-model soundness, retaining untensed IL and coherent PTQ correspondences
explicit_foundational_inputs: BooleanTruth and FunExt in source and target models

model_class_boundary.covered: all independent coherent valuations on all declared inhabited PTQ world-time frames
model_class_boundary.temporal_relations: same world and strictly later/earlier time
model_class_boundary.admissibility: nine source meaning-postulate families evaluated as translated target formulas
model_class_boundary.unrestricted_standard_target_models: defined but not included in the full tensed correspondence

untensed_model_class_boundary.covered: all independent standard models of the implemented target signature on arbitrary inhabited entity and index types
untensed_model_class_boundary.source: explicit untensed IL syntax embedded in the actual PTQ syntax; no Will or Has constructors
untensed_model_class_boundary.function_spaces: full internal Rocq function spaces, not external set equality or Henkin subdomains
untensed_model_class_boundary.theories: arbitrary predicates on formulas, not only finite premise lists
untensed_model_class_boundary.postulates: none imposed by the correspondence; object-language assumptions can be included in the theory
untensed_model_class_boundary.temporal_symbols: arbitrary and unused by translations; not recovered by the source-to-target round trip
untensed_model_class_boundary.target_formulas: minimal terms of type s -> t, applied to the arbitrary evaluation index

proof_calculus_boundary.source: Gallin p. 60, A1-A3, AS4 and R, in a typed locally indexed presentation
proof_calculus_boundary.axiom_instances: A1-A3 use contextual or named variables; AS4 uses capture-avoiding term substitution
proof_calculus_boundary.inference_rules: axiom introduction and one-occurrence replacement only; equality reasoning is derived
proof_calculus_boundary.assumptions: theorem calculus, not local-hypothesis consequence; R uses equality valid for all hole environments
proof_calculus_boundary.soundness: all derivations, signatures, assignments and environments in the full internal Boolean/function-space semantics
proof_calculus_boundary.source_connection: a derivation of the actual translated IL formula implies its standard semantic validity

source_review: AI-assisted primary-source consultation; no independent human review claimed
